boundary: Installed Chrome extension artifact, distinct from @oai npm packages. @core/browser-extension is this project's package name; no claim of an original @oai/browser-extension package.
thirdParty: This inspected transport uses Chrome nativeMessaging/alarms and standard timers. Sentry 10.48.0 is separately bundled; not copied into the transport. Broader dependency audit remains pending.
remaining: Production lower-layer wiring (tab leases/groups/favicons, shared debugger startup wiring, network policies, SIWC, overlay/monitors, mentions, startup), manifest and build/install packaging; native messaging host executable remains external.
sharedImplementation: Browser-service to and extension fc share protocol methods but preserve their distinct transport-field initialization order. Core extraction and factory are project refactoring boundaries. Request-header template parsing and expansion are shared between browser VC/u5 and extension cs/ls via project-created @core/core/requestHeaders.
